internal_schema: internal is never exposed through the API. Browser roles hold EXECUTE on its non-trigger functions only because RLS policies and SECURITY INVOKER code evaluate them as the caller.

server_only_internal_history.signature: emit_security_event(text, uuid, text, text, jsonb, uuid, uuid, uuid)
server_only_internal_history.reason: The only writer of security_events. Called by trusted database functions in the same transaction as the change; takes no actor argument. No API role holds EXECUTE.
BEFORE INSERT on security_events: derives actor, effective person, AAL and time server-side; refuses secret-shaped metadata keys.
BEFORE INSERT on audit_log: derives actor server-side and applies audit_redaction_rules to every audit image, whichever trusted path writes it.
BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on audit_log and security_events: refuses unless an operator session outside the API roles sets ovalball.maintenance.
Applies DROP/HASH/MASK redaction to an audit image.
Detects secret-shaped metadata keys at any depth.
AFTER UPDATE on profiles: emits account.suspended/disabled/restored and user.setup_completed.

club-logos.reason: Club crests on public pages and emails.

club-news-media.reason: Article hero images for anonymous readers and link previews. Known limitation: an image attached to a draft article is reachable by its unguessable UUID URL (handoff); tighten in a later content/security slice.

email-brand.reason: Email brand logo rendered in mail clients.

storage.anon_write_policies: none may admit anonymous callers without an authority helper

admin_club_overview row gate uses internal.is_site_admin() — replace with site.clubs.view in Slice 7.

authenticated reads every club_directory column (notes, official_email) because Site Admin pages select * as authenticated — column-restrict when Site Admin reads move to site-capability RPCs (Slice 7).

Identity/Auth Slice 3 removed the Site Admin club/team bypass from internal.has_capability; Site Admin authority is site capabilities (K rule 7). Remaining is_site_admin() RLS/function references retire in Slice 7.

append_only_history.reason: Phase 2 Y.14/Y.15 and AO B1: audit and security history is append-only. No application role writes either store directly; every append comes from a trusted database function or trigger owned by postgres, and attribution is derived from the request JWT.
append_only_history.maintenance_setting: ovalball.maintenance = 'on' in an operator session that is not anon, authenticated or service_role, not the PostgREST authenticator, and carries no request JWT (future retention job).

audit_log.writers: internal.audit_row_change() and trusted SECURITY DEFINER functions that insert their own entries
